title: How to access the >x< Handle Marketplace

runs: Log in to your >x< account.
Go to
. You can also access the >x< Handle Marketplace by clicking the “Request an inactive handle” tab in Premium Hub.
Search for available handles from the same account you want to use it on.
Request an available handle.
Accept the >x< Handle Marketplace Terms.
If you encounter issues, contact support via the support tool at
, accessible from the menu or bottom right of the screen.
How to request a handle transfer
Find an available handle in the Marketplace, then submit your request. You will need:
An eligible subscription.
Agreement to the
, including ongoing content creation (see “Maintaining your handle” below) and compliance with
For some handles: A transfer fee and an explanation of why you want the handle
Depending on the handle you’re requesting, you may be prompted to go through a short ID Verification process.
Most requests require at least 7 days for a decision, but depending on volume response times may vary.
Why requests might be denied
Handle requests may be denied by >x<, some common denial reasons include:
Ineligibility, e.g. missing the correct tier of premium subscription.
Policy violations or impersonation concerns.
Handle unavailability or reservation for other purposes.
Some listed Handles may receive multiple requests from a variety of users. We prioritize active, eligible users to help ensure handles drive positive engagement on the platform.
Maintaining your handle
Once your handle is transferred you must ensure you continue to meet the below criteria:

Create content regularly. If an account is active but the associated handle remains largely dormant – for example, where little or no original or engaging content is published – >x< may reclaim the handle.

Use the handle in a way that reflects the spirit of participation and expression on >x<. That means active involvement in platform activities (replying, reposting, discussing topics) that help build a vibrant community for sharing ideas and expressions. >x<’s intent is to ensure that handles remain available for active voices and creators who help advance the mission of the platform, not for speculation or inactivity.
Ensure regular activity on the platform, with a minimum of 1 device login within a 30 day period. For details, see our
Follow
, and

Users who did not pay a Transfer Price with their handle transfer must also maintain their subscription. If your subscription lapses, you have 30 days to reinstate it before we reclaim the handle. Non-compliance may lead to reclamation without notice or refund, except as required by law. Users who pay a transfer price for a handle only need the required subscription when they make payment, but do not need to maintain it after the handle has been transferred.
Failure to meet the above criteria may result in >x< reclaiming the handle without notice and without refund (except as required by law).
Please note that >x< owns the handles – you receive a limited, revocable non-transferable license to use them, subject to the

Costs and transfer price
Many handles, like firstname-lastname combinations or multi-word business names, can come as a perk with your Premium+, Premium Business Full Access, or Premium Organizations subscription.

Some handles are invite only and require payment of a Transfer Price, which varies by handle. This is most common for handles with higher commercially-related value. All payments are final and non-refundable. Taxes may apply via our payment platform.
What determines the transfer price?

If a transfer price is required by >x<, it is based on factors such as commercial value alongside rarity, demand, and market dynamics. Typical fees may start in the 5 figure region (USD) and span into the 7 figure range (USD). Prices may differ by release method.
The transfer process
If approved:
Pay any Transfer Price and complete business or personal verifications, if required by >x<.
We will transition your previous handle to the newly approved one.
Your followers, posts, DMs, and settings are unaffected.

Your previous handle is frozen for a period of time, meaning it is unavailable to other users. As part of the transfer process you’ll receive a limited, non-transferable license to your new handle. >x< owns and can reclaim any handle as per the
Can I transfer the handle to a different account?

Requests on the Handle Marketplace must come from the account you will use the handle on. You cannot request a handle you intend to use on another account. Premium Business users can contact support via the support tool at
, accessible from the menu or bottom right, for help with new account associations. Additional fees may apply for custom requests.
Reserved allocations for Premium Business Enterprise users
Enterprise Premium Business customers may be able to access exclusive reserved handles tailored to their brand or industry. Contact >x< Enterprise support via the support tool at
accessible from the menu or bottom right, to inquire about availability and custom allocations.
If a handle is unavailable
Unavailability could mean:
An active user still holds it.
It is ineligible for the Marketplace, like reserved or excluded per policy.
Other reasons, such as an ongoing review.

For some currently unavailable handles, you can use the “Register your interest option.” We will then attempt to notify you if the handle becomes available for request in the future. Enable email notifications within your >x< account settings to stay informed.
Preparing for a handle change
A new handle might confuse followers. Old tags or links could break. Once approved, we suggest you:
Post an announcement about the change.
Update your bio and profile.
Monitor for impersonation or missed interactions.
For tips, see Change your >x< username at
Limits on handle transfers

You are limited to one transfer every six months per account. Note that if you change your handle after receiving a handle through the >x< Handle Marketplace, >x< reclaims the Handle you previously received through the >x< Handle Marketplace.
To revert to your old handle, contact support via the support tool at
, accessible from the menu or bottom right. We will reclaim the Marketplace handle, which may again be made available to other eligible users to request.
Can I sell or transfer my handle?

No. Your license is non-transferable and for your use only. Attempts to sell or transfer will revoke rights, reclaim the handle without refund, and may result in >x< suspending involved accounts per our Rules. This includes the sale of the whole account to another entity. For any questions please reach out via the support tool at
, accessible from the menu or bottom right of the screen.
Canceling participation
To release your transferred handle, contact support via the support tool at
, accessible from the menu or bottom right. We will reclaim the Marketplace handle.
